name: Buildkite
description: Buildkite lets agents read pipelines, builds, jobs, logs and test results, and find why a build failed, in the organizations of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Buildkite account through the browser.

prompts.text: Why did the latest build on main fail?
Which tests failed most often in the last week of builds?
Show the status of the open builds for this branch.

apps.name: Buildkite
apps.description: Pipelines, builds, job logs, and test results, over Buildkite's MCP server with browser sign-in.
